whatIs: Remotion is a framework for creating videos and animated graphics by programming with React. Every video is code: you can preview and edit it in Remotion Studio, render it on your server or in the browser, and embed it in your app with its Player.
It's a good fit when you want to generate videos from templates and data, or you'd rather animate with components than with a traditional editor.
uses: Batch-generating personalized videos from data, such as activity summaries for each user.
Embedding an interactive video in your React app with the Player.
Producing animations and graphics for social media or presentations while keeping them as versioned code.
caveats: It's free for individuals, nonprofits and companies of up to 3 people; other companies need a Company License.
If a client receives or operates the Remotion project, their employees count toward your total for that limit; if you only hand over the finished video, they don't.
It assumes you know React, and rendering many videos requires your own infrastructure, for example Remotion Lambda on your AWS account.
pricingNote: The license is free for up to 3 people; the Company License starts at $0.01 per render (minimum $100 a month) or $25 per seat a month, and Enterprise starts at $500 a month.
idealFor: React developers who want to produce videos with code.
